<h5>
**About me**
<hr class="new1"></hr>

<p> I am an Associate Professor in the Department of Mathematical and Computational Sciences at [Yachay Tech University](https://www.yachaytech.edu.ec/). 

I graduated in mathematics from Universidade Federal do Pará (Brazil), and I received my Master's and Ph.D. degrees in pure mathematics at the State University of Campinas (Brazil) in the field of Stochastic Dynamical Systems. I have been in internships and scientific visits at the University of Evansville and Imperial College London, where he created a strong network with world-renowned scientists. </p>

<p> My research interests are stochastic analysis and probability, stochastic optimal control, Lévy processes, decomposition of flows, rough paths, and stochastic dynamics in Lie groups, among others. </p>
</h5>
